questions.q: A sum becomes ₹6,600 in 2 years and ₹7,920 in 3 years at compound interest. What is the original principal?
questions.s:
Given:

Amount after 2 years A2 = ₹6,600

Amount after 3 years A3 = ₹7,920

Formula used:

An = P × (1 + r)n

Calculations:

⇒ A3 / A2 = (1 + r)

⇒ 7920 / 6600 = 1 + r

⇒ 1 + r = 1.2

⇒ r = 20%

Now,

⇒ 6600 = P × (1.2)2

⇒ 6600 = P × 1.44

⇒ P = 6600 / 1.44

⇒ P = 4583.33

∴ The original principal is ₹4,583.33.

questions.q: What is the product of (x + a) and (x + b)?
o: x2 + (a + b)x + ab
x2 + (a - b)x + ab
x2 + (a + b)x - ab
x2 + (a - ab)x - ab
questions.s:
Concept used:

(m + n)(k + l) = m(k + l) + n(k + l) = mk + ml + nk + nl

Calculations:

According to the question,

(x + a)(x + b) 

= x(x + b) + a(x+b)

= x2 + bx + ax + ab

= x2 + (a + b)x + ab

Hence, The Required value is x2 + (a + b)x + ab.

questions_hin.q_hi: What is the product of (x + a) and (x + b)?
o_hi: x2 + (a + b)x + ab
x2 + (a - b)x + ab
x2 + (a + b)x - ab
x2 + (a - ab)x - ab
questions_hin.s_hi:
Concept used:

(m + n)(k + l) = m(k + l) + n(k + l) = mk + ml + nk + nl

Calculations:

According to the question,

(x + a)(x + b) 

= x(x + b) + a(x+b)

= x2 + bx + ax + ab

= x2 + (a + b)x + ab

Hence, The Required value is x2 + (a + b)x + ab.
